parameters.description: Words to find in the office's name, acronym or former name, such as 'impôts Rennes' or 'pôle emploi'. Accents don't matter.

Pick one, or type its code (caf), its name, or several codes separated by commas (caf, cpam).
parameters.name: office_type

parameters.description: Only one kind of entry: local public offices (town halls, CAF, France Travail...), State services in the regions and departments (prefectures, departmental directorates), or national bodies (ministries, courts, independent authorities, embassies). parameters.description: For State services and national bodies, which have no office type: the kind of organisation, such as Administration centrale (ou Ministère), Ambassade ou mission diplomatique, Juridiction or Préfecture, sous-préfecture.
parameters.name: organisation_type

parameters.description: Only offices in the commune with this INSEE code: five characters such as 75056 for Paris or 2A004 for Ajaccio. It is not the postcode. Paris, Lyon and Marseille's code also covers their arrondissements. Several can be given, separated by commas.
parameters.name: citycode

parameters.description: Only offices whose address has this five-digit postcode. Several can be given, separated by commas. A postcode read out of a spreadsheet as a number (1500) is padded back (01500).
parameters.name: postcode

parameters.description: Only offices in a town or city with this name, such as Rennes. Capitals and accents don't matter.
parameters.name: city

parameters.description: Only offices in this department, by its number: 35, 2A, or 971 for Guadeloupe. Several can be given, separated by commas. National bodies have no commune, so this leaves them out.
parameters.name: department

parameters.description: Only offices in this region's departments. National bodies have no commune, so this leaves them out.
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: Only the offices with this 14-digit SIRET, or of the body with this 9-digit SIREN, such as a public customer's on an invoice.
parameters.name: siret

parameters.description: How many offices to return, from 1 to 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: How many matches to skip, for the next page: give the previous result's next_offset. Defaults to 0.

attribution.description: The credit the data's licence asks for: 'Annuaire de l'administration, Service-Public.gouv.fr (DILA)'.

count.description: How many offices this page holds.

has_more.description: True when more matches follow this page.

next_offset.description: The offset of the next page, or empty on the last one.

offices.description: The offices on this page, in name order.

acronym.description: The acronym the office is known by, e.g. 'DGER'.

address.description: Where the office is, with its GPS position. Empty when the directory gives none.

city.description: The town or city, e.g. 'Paris' or 'Toulon Cedex'.

complement.description: A building, floor or department named before the street.

country.description: The country, e.g. 'France', or the host country of an embassy.

label.description: The whole address on one line, e.g. '47 rue de la Chapelle, 75018 Paris'.

latitude.description: Latitude of the address, in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the address, in decimal degrees.

po_box.description: A PO box or Cedex delivery code, e.g. 'CS 31209' or 'BP 123'.

postcode.description: The five-digit postcode (empty for an office abroad).

street.description: The number and street, e.g. '47 rue de la Chapelle'.

category.description: 'local' (a local public office), 'state_local' (a State service in a region or département) or 'national' (a national body).

commune_code.description: The INSEE code of the office's commune, e.g. '75118'.

email.description: The office's own public email address, when it publishes one.

id.description: The office's id in the directory, for 'Get office' and 'List sub-offices'.

latitude.description: Latitude of the office, in decimal degrees.

longitude.description: Longitude of the office, in decimal degrees.

name.description: The office's name, e.g. "Caisse d'allocations familiales (Caf) de Paris - accueil La Chapelle".

opening_hours_text.description: The opening hours on one line, e.g. 'Mon-Fri 08:30-12:00 and 14:00-16:00', with any note such as 'by appointment'.

organisation_type.description: For State services and national bodies, the kind of organisation, e.g. 'Préfecture, sous-préfecture' or 'Ambassade ou mission diplomatique'.

phone.description: The office's main phone number, as the directory writes it.

type_label.description: The name of its first type, e.g. 'France Travail'.

types.description: The office's types (a local office usually has one; national bodies have none).

label.description: DILA's name for the type, e.g. "Caisse d'allocations familiales (Caf)".

updated_at.description: When the directory last updated the entry (ISO 8601).

offset.description: How many matches were skipped before this page.

summary.description: One line saying what was found.

total.description: How many offices match in all.

description: Look up France's public offices in the state's official directory on Service-Public.gouv.fr: about 94,000 town halls, prefectures, CAF and CPAM offices, France Travail agencies, tax offices, courts, ministries and embassies. Search them by name, type and place, find the offices that serve a commune or are nearest a point, and get each one's address, GPS position, phone, email, website, opening hours and parent body. Adresse finds where an address or a town hall is; this adds who to contact there, when it is open and which office handles which commune. No account or API key required.
